Pairing instructions

Use Chrome or Edge on a Bluetooth-equipped Mac or Windows PC. Keep the board off, power on your V2+ remote and press its multi-button five times quickly. Choose Connect remote and select it in the Bluetooth chooser. Pairing can take up to 45 seconds.
